headings.usage: Use for all headings. Keep tracking tight (tracking-tight) on larger header text.

body.usage: Use for all body text, paragraphs, captions, and smaller UI text. Maintain leading-relaxed for body copy.

typography.hierarchy_rules: H1 max text-4xl on mobile, text-5xl on desktop. Do not exceed text-5xl. Eyebrow labels or small tags must be uppercase, text-xs, with tracking-wider.

colors.rules: No complete transparent backgrounds for header/overlays. Use bg-white/90 with backdrop-blur-md for sticky headers. Primary #FF3E6C ONLY for high-intent CTAs (Add to Bag, BuyReady Unlock).

borders.radius: rounded-lg to rounded-2xl for soft cards. Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for tags and chips.

visual_enhancers.effects: Glassmorphism for bottom sheets, sticky navs, and sticky bottom CTAs (bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl). Never use flat muddy transparency.

components.Button: Pill-shaped or rounded-md. Primary CTA is full-width sticky at the bottom on mobile ('Add to Bag') with #FF3E6C background.
components.Card: Soft rounded cards, generous internal padding (p-4 to p-6). No harsh black shadows.
components.BottomSheet: Framer Motion slide-up sheet for 'Why Is This Recommended'. bg-white with a top drag handle.
components.Tabs: Underline transition tabs (using Framer Motion layoutId) for smooth switching in the bottom sheet.
components.TrustStrip: Always visible footer. Icons + Text: 100% Original, Easy Returns, Secure Payment, Trusted by Millions.
components.BuyReadyLayer: Custom decision component on PDP featuring Fit Profile Card, Delivery Prediction, and BuyReady Hero Card.

grids_and_layouts.mobile_first: Design primarily for mobile devices (360px width) scaling up smoothly.
grids_and_layouts.desktop_strategy: On desktop, use responsive grids (grid-cols-1 mobile -> grid-cols-3 or 4 desktop) for product listings. The layout should remain generous, avoiding cramped UI.
grids_and_layouts.product_grid: grid-cols-2 on mobile, grid-cols-4 on desktop. gap-4.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-4 on mobile, p-8 on desktop. Containers with borders need internal padding (p-4 to p-6).

motion.BuyReady_Unlock: Scale up with spring physics, green #03A685 glowing border or fill upon unlocking the insight.
motion.Confidence_Bar: Width expansion from 0 to X% using Framer Motion (duration 0.8s, easeOut) to visualize fit/trust confidence.
motion.Bottom_Sheet: Slide from 100% Y to 0% Y. (type: 'spring', damping: 25, stiffness: 200).
motion.Page_Transitions: Subtle fade (opacity 0 to 1) and y-offset (5px to 0px).

accessibility.contrast: Text must pass WCAG AA. Grey text (#7E818C) should be highly legible on white.
accessibility.interactive: Every interactive element MUST have data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='add-to-bag-btn').

product_women.description: Woman in casual hoodie and jeans

3d_libraries: Framer Motion (for all requested layout/UI animations: bottom sheets, confidence bars, BuyReady unlocks). No 3D libraries (Three.js/R3F) required for this specific UI.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'BuyReady - Pre-Purchase Decision Layer' as a custom card component on the PDP, utilizing Framer Motion for the 'unlock' entrance and confidence bar fill.
Create a reusable BottomSheet component using framer-motion (drag='y') for the 'Why Is This Recommended' feature.
Implement standard e-commerce features: PLP grid, Wishlist toggle (heart icon), Cart drawer, and standard checkout flow.
The sticky 'Add to Bag' button on mobile PDP MUST be fixed at the bottom with a z-index of 50 and use the #FF3E6C primary color.
The Trust Strip footer must be rendered globally on the App or layout level.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this. Make it feel premium, like a top 1% app.
Do not make generic centered layouts. DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and soft shadows.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers and bottom sheet overlays. Never use fully transparent headers.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add specific transitions for interactable elements to avoid breaking transforms.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='buy-ready-btn').
NEVER use placeholder text for images, use the provided image URLs.
NEVER use emoji characters for icons, use 'lucide-react'.
